page_description_chirho: Find your way through saving, previewing, publishing and recovering your Perffection page.
eyebrow_chirho: A little help, whenever you need it
introduction_chirho: Keep your words, check your page, and know what happens before you put it online. Choose the part you need help with.
start_body_chirho: You can read this guide without an account. To work on your own page, sign in first, then open your workspace.

access_chirho.heading_chirho: Sign in and get back to work
access_chirho.introduction_chirho: Use the sign-in name and password for your existing account. A new account would not bring your saved work with it.
steps_chirho: Enter the sign-in name for your existing account. This is not your email address or your public website address.
Use your current password. If you changed it, the earlier password will no longer work.
If you have tried several times, pause before trying again. Never send anyone your password.
access_chirho.question_chirho: What if I have lost my sign-in details?
access_chirho.answer_chirho: Check your password manager for your sign-in name and current password. Automatic recovery of lost access is not available yet. Creating another account will not recover the work saved in your existing one.

save_chirho.introduction_chirho: Editing changes the form. Saving creates a private version you can return to. Neither action publishes your page.
steps_chirho: Add your business name, a headline, an introduction and at least one complete service. Include a phone number or email address customers may use.
Choose Save and check the saved version shown on the returned page.
If a field needs attention, your submitted words stay in the editor. Correct the highlighted fields and save again.
save_chirho.question_chirho: What if another window saved a newer version?
save_chirho.answer_chirho: The newer saved version is kept. Your attempted words remain in the form so you can compare and edit them. Check what you want to keep before saving again; do not reload before copying any unsaved words you still need.

publish_chirho.introduction_chirho: Preview shows your saved draft. The Publishing page is where you approve the version and address other people will see.
steps_chirho: Save your changes, then open Preview. Check the wording and the contact details.
Open Publishing, review the saved version and choose an available address. Read the publication notice before approving.
A version on its way is still being processed. Reload Publishing to check progress. Once it is marked live, open the public address to check it.
For later changes, save and preview again, then approve the update on Publishing. Saving alone does not update the public page.
publish_chirho.question_chirho: What if publication is refused or the address changed?
publish_chirho.answer_chirho: Read the reason on Publishing. Choose another address if yours is unavailable. If a newer version was saved or published, reopen Publishing and review it before approving again. A refused update does not replace the page already live.

history_chirho.introduction_chirho: Restoring a private draft and rolling back a public page are two different actions.
steps_chirho: To recover earlier words, choose a version in the editor's saved history. Restoring it creates a new private version; it does not change the public page.
Preview the restored draft. If you want it online, approve it separately on Publishing.
To return the public address to earlier published content, choose an available rollback on Publishing and wait until that entry is live.
history_chirho.question_chirho: Can every earlier version always be restored?
history_chirho.answer_chirho: Use the versions currently offered in your history. Keep a downloaded copy of content you need to retain. A rollback brings back your published words with today's page design; it does not bring back an older design.

export_chirho.heading_chirho: Keep a copy of your words
export_chirho.introduction_chirho: Copy my page document downloads the content of one saved version. Treat it as your own document, especially if it contains contact details.
steps_chirho: Save the version you want to keep, then open Copy my page document and download it.
To bring that content back later, open Recover page content and paste the document.
Review the imported words in the editor. Nothing is saved or published until you explicitly choose those actions.
export_chirho.question_chirho: Is this a backup of my whole account?
export_chirho.answer_chirho: No. It contains the page's words and contact fields, not your password, account, complete version history, publication permissions or website software.

own_agent_chirho.introduction_chirho: You can bring an answer from the AI you already use. Our public guide tells it the shape your page needs.
steps_chirho: Give your agent the guide and the business information you want to use. Never share your Perffection password or access keys.
In your workspace, open Use your own AI and paste its answer. This is different from restoring an exported page document.
Review and correct the words in the editor before saving. Saving does not publish your page.
own_agent_chirho.question_chirho: Does this use my Perffection AI credits?
own_agent_chirho.answer_chirho: No platform AI call is made on this path. Your own agent or provider may charge under its terms. You remain in control of what you save and publish.
own_agent_chirho.action_label_chirho: Read the guide for your agent

privacy_chirho.introduction_chirho: Your workspace draft is not your public website. Publication is the separate act that makes the approved page content public.
steps_chirho: Before publishing, check that the words, phone number and email address are intended for the public.
Never put passwords, access codes, private customer records or payment details in your page content.
Assume published content can be copied. Replacing or rolling back the page does not erase earlier copies or every retained published object.
privacy_chirho.question_chirho: Should I send a password when asking for help?
privacy_chirho.answer_chirho: No. Describe what you were trying to do and the message you saw. Remove passwords, access codes and private customer details from anything you share.
privacy_chirho.action_label_chirho: Read about trust and current limits
